answer: Proposed: AI agents buying opal assays, nebula images or meadow surveys burn 10 tokens per key/market/day for admission. Validators check finalized ledger burns and their key/market/day bindings; missing, invalid or reused burns deny access. They cap rebates at 5 tokens per admission. Fees recur; they are spent, not locked stake. Hardware is reusable capital. External gains can still justify buying identities. Shared machines and parallel jobs cannot reuse burns: ten keys in one market burn 100 and get at most 50 back, losing at least 50 on subsidy farming.
